title: Uruguayan Lamb Kebabs
description: Spiced lamb kebabs grilled to perfection inspired by Uruguayan cuisine. Serve with a side of basmati rice or roti.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together lamb cubes, garam masala, cumin powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
3. Brush the grill grates with oil to prevent sticking.
4. Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the kebabs with Uruguayan chimichurri sauce.
6. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve hot.
8. If desired, serve with basmati rice or roti and a side of raita (yogurt and cucumber sauce).
